relations.name: invoice_record
relations.meaning: One represented billed-revenue invoice row as recorded in billing sources.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to invoices.json row by invoice_id.
relations.construction_rule: Parse sources/billing/invoices.json; mint one referent per invoice_id; assert field values verbatim.

relations.name: crm_account_record
relations.meaning: One CRM account row as recorded in the CRM export.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to crm.csv row by crm_account_id.
relations.construction_rule: Parse sources/crm.csv; mint referent crm:<crm_account_id>; assert fields verbatim.

relations.name: registry_company_record
relations.meaning: One company-registry row as recorded in the registry export.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to company_registry.csv row by company_number.
relations.construction_rule: Parse sources/company_registry.csv; mint referent registry:<company_number>; assert fields verbatim.

relations.name: contract_record
relations.meaning: One contract or statement-of-work document with header metadata as recorded in source markdown.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/contracts/<contract_id>.md header fields.
relations.construction_rule: Parse contract markdown headers; mint referent contract:<filename_without_md>; extract counterparty, dates, term text, and document_kind (MSA, SOW, advisory, etc.).

relations.name: contract_clause_record
relations.meaning: One verbatim contractual clause block under a named section in a source contract document.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to the section span in sources/contracts/<contract_id>.md.
relations.construction_rule: Segment contract markdown by section headings; assert section label and verbatim clause body.

relations.name: commercial_note_record
relations.meaning: One non-heading paragraph from internal commercial notes as an auxiliary source observation.
relations.grounding_contract: Each tuple grounded to sources/commercial_notes.md paragraph index.
relations.construction_rule: Split commercial_notes.md into numbered paragraphs; mint thin referents; store verbatim text.

relations.name: identity_judgment
relations.meaning: Two cross-system identifiers denote the same legal counterparty, are distinct, or remain unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: Bounded packet. SAME_ENTITY and DISTINCT require establishing evidence, not compatibility.
relations.construction_rule: Resolve each required identity-link candidate using registry names, VAT/tax IDs, contract counterparty names, CRM names, billing billed names, and commercial notes; apply mechanical legal-form normalization only where sources support exact registered-name variants.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Emit unordered pairs from required_identity_link where left < right lexicographically; skip pairs already dispositioned.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether left and right identifiers denote the same legal counterparty.

relations.name: invoice_contract_association
relations.meaning: A billed invoice can be confidently linked to a governing contract counterparty, or that join remains open.
relations.grounding_contract: ASSERTED requires confident join evidence across billing billed_name and contract counterparty_name (possibly via identity_judgment); UNRESOLVED must cite the open join, not silent absence.
relations.construction_rule: For each invoice and candidate governing contract, judge whether billed_name and contract counterparty_name refer to the same commercial relationship; consume identity_judgment where identifiers differ in surface form.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Cartesian filter: pair each invoice_record with contract_record rows that plausibly govern the same commercial relationship (same counterparty family or explicit note linkage).
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the invoice billed party is the counterparty named on the contract.

relations.name: obligation_kind_attribution
relations.meaning: An active contract's text supports classifying a stated obligation kind (exclusivity, auto_renewal, or rolling_term), denies it, or leaves classification open.
relations.grounding_contract: PRESENT and NOT_PRESENT require bounded clause-text evidence from contract_clause_record and contract_record term fields; UNRESOLVED cites ambiguous or insufficient text.
relations.construction_rule: Read contract clauses and term description; classify obligation_kind against exclusivity, auto_renewal, and rolling_term definitions used by purpose C.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: For each contract_record, emit one candidate per obligation_kind in {exclusivity, auto_renewal, rolling_term}.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether contract text supports the given obligation_kind.

relations.name: acquisition_relevant_condition
relations.meaning: Under purpose A acquisition policy, a contract clause counts as an acquisition-relevant condition of the given kind, is ruled out, or remains unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: PRESENT requires bounded clause-text evidence; UNRESOLVED cites ambiguous text; NOT_PRESENT only when text clearly fails the purpose A policy for that kind.
relations.construction_rule: Map contract_clause_record text to purpose A acquisition-relevant kinds: change_of_control_consent, change_of_control_termination, assignment_notice_or_consent, assignment_consent, assignment_notice, assignment_competitor_prohibition, competitor_assignment_prohibition.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: For each contract_record and each allowed condition_kind in purpose A policy, emit one candidate tuple.
relations.unresolved_judgment: Whether the contract contains an acquisition-relevant condition of the given kind under purpose A policy.

relations.name: open_invoice
relations.meaning: Invoice whose billing status is recorded as open.
relations.grounding_contract: Derived from invoice_record.status with SOURCE grounding to the billing row.
relations.construction_rule: SELECT invoice_id FROM invoice_record WHERE status = 'open'.

relations.name: active_contract_for_purpose_a
relations.meaning: Contract treated as active under purpose A policy (expired statements of work excluded).
relations.grounding_contract: Derived from contract_record dates and document_kind applying purpose A active-contract rule.
relations.construction_rule: Include contract_id when document_kind is not an expired SOW and expiry_date is absent or after the evaluation reference; exclude SOW rows with recorded expiry in the past.

relations.name: active_contract_for_purpose_c
relations.meaning: Contract treated as active under purpose C policy (not expired).
relations.grounding_contract: Derived from contract_record expiry_date and term fields under purpose C non-expired rule.
relations.construction_rule: Include contract_id when expiry_date is absent or contract text supports continuing term; exclude contracts with recorded past expiry and no continuing term.

relations.name: required_identity_link
relations.meaning: Identifier pair that must receive an identity_judgment to connect CRM, billing, contract, and registry candidates for a commercially relevant relationship.
relations.grounding_contract: Derived candidate set over mechanical records; completeness scoped to required commercial relationships.
relations.construction_rule: For each CRM account with a governing contract and billed invoices, emit links among crm:, billing:, contract:, and registry: identifiers that must close the relationship chain; include note-suggested pairs.
relations.candidate_generation_rule: Orient pairs with left < right lexicographically for downstream identity_judgment orientation.

relations.name: purpose_a_qualifying_invoice
relations.meaning: Invoice row included in purpose A output: counterparty has an active contract with at least one acquisition-relevant condition and association is asserted or unresolved.
relations.grounding_contract: Join invoice_record, active_contract_for_purpose_a, acquisition_relevant_condition (PRESENT), and invoice_contract_association; map ASSERTED/UNRESOLVED to output association field.
relations.construction_rule: Include invoice when linked contract is active_for_purpose_a and has any acquisition_relevant_condition with PRESENT; set association from invoice_contract_association disposition (ASSERTED or UNRESOLVED only).

relations.name: commercial_dependency_row
relations.meaning: Purpose C dependency candidate row with status dependent or unresolved per purpose C conjunction policy.
relations.grounding_contract: Join active_contract_for_purpose_c, open_invoice, obligation_kind_attribution, identity_judgment, and invoice_contract_association; unresolved identity or joins force status unresolved.
relations.construction_rule: Emit one row per counterparty-contract candidate where a current relationship (open invoice or active rolling/auto-renew contract) and a PRESENT obligation_kind may apply; status dependent only when both prongs satisfied and joins resolve; otherwise unresolved.

limitations: Purpose D vocabulary intentionally omitted per pass instructions.
commercial_dependency_row aggregates open_invoice_ids and obligation_kinds as TEXT roles for derivation packaging; rendering to purpose_ir/c/output.json arrays is a downstream serialization concern.
No closed-world negation for invoice_contract_association: absence of ASSERTED is not persisted as a negative association tuple.
